_comment: The manifest of @abap2ui5/frontend - the abap2UI5 UI5 component (app/webapp)
as an npm package. tools/pack-frontend.mjs copies it into a STAGING directory
outside the checkout, sets the version to the framework's, records the commit
under `abap2ui5`, drops this comment and packs there. The version below is
deliberately a placeholder: `npm run check:version` holds the framework's
version in package.json and z2ui5_if_app=>version - not here.
name: @abap2ui5/frontend
description: The abap2UI5 frontend: the UI5 component z2ui5 that renders what an abap2UI5 backend sends. A UI5 tooling project of type module, with its Component-preload.js - for a UI5 app that embeds abap2UI5, a static host or a CDN.
